That silence is on us, and I'm sorry. An RMA should be processed within ten days of reaching the warehouse, and yours arrived August 28, so it is well past that.

Before I say anything about the record, confirm one detail for me: the email address on the order. Then I'll get this in front of the team today with everything you've told me.

Hello, I wish to know something about my ····. It was delivered at Shipbob inc. august 28th. I have written a mail at support@ september 16th, 22nd and 29th. I also written in this chat this monday, it was told to me that Abel or someones would get back to me, but I never received an answer. I don’t know what to think…

I hear you, and I'm sorry you've had to chase this. Your RMA reached the warehouse on August 28, well past the ten days it should take, and nobody came back to you. That's not good enough.

I've put it in front of Abel and Georges with your dates, and they're on right now.

One thing from you so I can open the record: the email address the order was placed under.
(email hidden)

Thanks, Claudio, that matches. Order Shop····, the NerdQX, delivered to you on August 10.

On our side the return has not been processed: there's no replacement unit and no refund recorded against it. So nothing has moved since the warehouse received it, which is exactly why you've heard nothing.

That decision, replacement or money back, is Abel's or Georges', and they have this now with your dates. Stay in the chat and one of them will come in here.
How long will it take? I’m waiting from 50 minutes

I can't give you a time, and I won't invent one. The team is on until 6pm Eastern, so today is realistic, but it depends when one of them gets free.

You don't have to sit here. Everything you've told me is on the case, and the answer goes to (email hidden), so you'll get it whether you stay or not.

I'm still here in the meantime if you want anything checked.
Last monday too it was told to me that I would get an answer by mail, but I haven’t received it…

That's fair, and I'm not going to ask you to just trust it again.

I've pushed it back to the team a second time, marked as a person needed now, with Monday's broken promise on it. Your RMA number, your three emails and the August 28 delivery are all on the case.

What I can't do myself is process the return or move the money, so I won't pretend otherwise. If nobody has come back to you by Monday, come straight back here and say so.

Ok thank you, I know that you have done anything you can

Thank you for being patient about it, Claudio. It shouldn't have taken this many messages.

If Monday comes and it's still quiet, come back and tell me.
